As of the latest information available up to October 2023, Dell offers a range of servers that can be configured with various GPU options, often including NVIDIA GPUs. The NVIDIA A40 is a high-performance data center GPU primarily designed for professional visualization workloads, such as virtual workstations, rendering, and AI model development.

Dell typically provides customizable solutions, allowing customers to configure servers with the specific hardware needed, including different GPU options. If you are looking for a specific server model with NVIDIA A40 GPUs, I recommend checking Dell's official website or contacting their sales representatives directly for the most current information on available configurations and to confirm whether A40 GPUs can be included in their server offerings.

Server offerings can change frequently based on supply chain and technological advancements, so direct contact with Dell is the best way to ensure you have the most up-to-date information.
